title: The Health and Wellness Education Database — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Real information from reliable public sources and official catalogs, fact-checked reference. Reliable general educational resources on sleep, exercise, nutrition, and stress management. The Health and Wellness Education Database collects reliable general educational resources on sleep, exercise, nutrition, and stress management from reputable health organizations. Content is educational, never diagnostic, and records link to the source guidance. The Signature side adds habit-building plans that turn guidance into sustainable routines.

Keep content educational, never diagnostic
